title: A web URI in an RFC 9116 field must begin with https://

cites.quote: If this field indicates a web URI, then it MUST begin with "https://" (as per Section 2.7.2 of [RFC7230]).
cites.note: Transcribed from a live fetch of https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9116.txt on 2026-10-29 (file sha256 79d19ce7a4a35496981095a27fd992797a9fc4d6f3649c2a1e14f494607c61f9). The same sentence appears, word for word, under Acknowledgments (line 248), Canonical (269), Contact (292), Encryption (320), Hiring (359) and Policy (368). CSAF is not an RFC 9116 field; security-txt-csaf-not-https covers it.

policy_note: A web URI that does not begin with https:// is one with the http scheme, so the test flags values whose scheme is http (beginning with http:, with or without //, as sectxt keys on the scheme) and nothing else. Values with other schemes (mailto:, tel:, dns:, openpgp4fpr:) are not web URIs and pass. The scheme compares case-insensitively (RFC 3986 §3.1), so HTTP: is flagged too. One finding lists every offending field and value.
applicability: A security.txt body with at least one Acknowledgments, Canonical, Contact, Encryption, Hiring or Policy value.
expectation: No value of those six fields matches /^http:/i.
